Relics.name: Catalyst
Relics.description: Every 7 <link=Glossary/Hit><color=#FFFA67>hit</color></link>, explode all <link=Glossary/DotDamage><color=#FFFA67>dot damage</color></link> on enemies.

Relics.name: Strength Dice
Relics.description: When <link=Glossary/TakeTurn><color=#FFFA67>take turn</color></link>, add random stack of <link=Effects/Strength><color=#FFFA67>strength</color></link> to player

Glossary.name: Hit
Glossary.description: A successful attack against an enemy.

Glossary.name: Bounce
Glossary.description: A hit on wall or obstacle.

Glossary.name: Turn Start
Glossary.description: The time before all player's and enemy's turn.

Glossary.name: Turn End
Glossary.description: The time after all player's and enemy's turn.

Glossary.name: Take Turn
Glossary.description: When player or enemy start their turn.

Glossary.name: Dot Damage
Glossary.description: Effects that deal damage when <link=Glossary/TakeTurn><color=#FFFA67>take turn</color></link>.
